items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Morello? [INTERVIEWEE] No Joe was gone by then.

ctx.x: to that, when I was 14. But let me preface that by saying that because my eyes were bad at that time we used to go to New York. And we’d go to the Taft Hotel when Vincent Lopez’s band was playing. Because my father — we would stay at the Taft and they used to have a thing called “Shake the Maracas” contest, which was a radio show. And they had me sit in on drums at 14. I’ve got photos of it. And man I was more nervous than a prostitute in church. Or you could say a whore in church. But you can edit that too. So…

No Joe was gone by then. But the drummer that I did see there was Jake Hanna. And that was my first meeting with Jake. But let’s see, okay, so anyway, let’s get back to when I was 15, during that summer break, I had played with the band, okay, in the fall, at age 15 I had been released from my medical restrictions because of the mononucleosis, to go back to school. The phone rings and now they want me to play at Memory Lane with the Salt City Six. And now this job went on, they used to go from nine to one or nine…
